title: Lamborghini unveils Revuelto SV, its most powerful production car ever
summary_full: Lamborghini's Revuelto SV is a limited-edition V12 hybrid with over 1,050 horsepower, a 2.4-second 0-to-100 kph time and a $741,172 starting price.
